gates.title: Every part design passed its own 12 gates and has a handoff STEP
gates.failure_means: a part is wrong on its own, before any placement
gates.knob: the part's own pipeline (correct that design)

gates.title: Every body of the bill of materials is in the export, once, with a placement
gates.failure_means: a body is missing, duplicated or fused

gates.title: Every joint's child frame lies on its parent frame (axis, offset, rest angle)
gates.failure_means: a body sits off its joint axis or at the wrong offset or phase
gates.knob: the placement transforms in the assembly source

gates.title: Static clearances and seats at rest
gates.failure_means: bodies interpenetrate or do not seat at rest
gates.knob: the placement (or the part if its interface is wrong)

gates.title: Every drive moves through its range without interference; gears mesh; ratios match tooth counts
gates.failure_means: the machine jams, collides or is geared wrong
gates.knob: phasing and placement in the assembly source, or the part geometry

gates.title: Each fluid region is one sealed piece within its volume band and agrees with the source's fluid body
gates.failure_means: the analyses would run on a leaking or wrong fluid region
gates.knob: walls and caps in the parts, the fluid booleans in the source

gates.title: Each exported body equals its part handoff x placement; the assembled envelope matches
gates.failure_means: a body was rebuilt, scaled or clipped instead of placed

gates.title: Every predicted observable meets the requirement the sources state
gates.failure_means: the machine does not do what the sources require at an operating case
gates.knob: the design (a new change request), never the inputs

gates.title: Energy, mass and force balances of every analysis close within their tolerance
gates.failure_means: an analysis created or lost energy/mass: its predictions are not evidence
gates.knob: the analysis setup (boundaries, time step), never a fitted input

gates.title: Mesh/time-step refinement changes each prediction by less than its tolerance
gates.failure_means: the prediction depends on the mesh: discretisation error is unbounded

gates.title: The assembly source imports only its declared inputs, formats and lints clean
evidence: results/build123d/disc-brake/verify.json hygiene: cad_refs=[] truth_refs=[]; ruff format True, ruff check True
gates.failure_means: the source reads files it must not, or is unformatted

gates.title: Every face of a bounded body carries exactly one named boundary
gates.failure_means: an analysis would load a surface nobody named
gates.knob: boundary selectors in the contract (a drafting fix) or a missing face in the part

gates.title: Stage JSONs carry provenance stamps; part handoffs are hash-bound; inputs carry provenance
evidence: results/build123d/disc-brake/<stage>.json provenance present for ['verify', 'kinematics', 'domains', 'simulate']; parts.json designs.<d>.step_sha256 present: True
gates.failure_means: an artefact cannot be traced to its inputs

gates.title: No worker-visible artefact reads truth; the assembly source only places declared inputs
gates.failure_means: evaluator truth leaked into the design
